text:
mike_sales: Quick sync  Prospect 'ClearBank' asking capacity guidance. Traffic: peak ~520 qps mixed chat+embeds, chat avg 50 tokens, p95 ~230 tokens, embeddings ~100 rps. They propose 10 reserved GPUs + burst to 20 and want KMS/audit answers.

anna_ops: TL;DR: 10 reserved is a defensible commit if we rely on KV preheat + batching. Without caching you'd need ~80-120 GPUs to hit p95 at peak for a 70B-class model. With 50-65% KV hit and smart batching, reserved=10 + burst_to_20 is OK as a start. Recommend 2-AZ spread and canary rules.

dylan_ml: Quick numbers: p95 throughput per A100-like GPU for long seq (~230) ~3 RPS; for short seq ~10 RPS. If chat mix has many short queries, effective footprint drops. Plan: preheat top 7k prefixes, session affinity to improve KV locality. Expect warmup token overhead ~1.5% daily.

jen_devops: Ops snippet for proposal:

```
model: rw-quant-70b
reserved_gpus: "10"
autoscale_min: "10"
autoscale_max: "20"
max_burst_gpus: "10"
preheat:
  kv_warmup: "true"
  warmup_targets: "top_7k"
  warmup_window: "25m"
az_strategy: "2-way"
fallback_variant: "13b-quant"
```

jen_devops: Add: circuit-breaker if queue latency >200ms for >90s -> shift traffic to 13B. Canary 5% traffic on new capacity for 10m.

sara_security: Security checklist to send: we support customer-managed KMS, can export inference metadata (request id, model, timestamp) to SIEM, RBAC for control plane, and private/VPC control plane for Private deployment. Private/KMS integration lead time ~6-8 weeks.

poc-bot: Reminder: schedule 90m POC smoke test. Preheat 30m prior. Load pattern: 30m baseline, 10m ramp, 20m peak at 520 qps, 20m soak, 10m cool-down. Include embeddings ~20% of requests.

mike_sales: Actions: @jen_devops run cost sketch for (10 reserved + burst 20) vs (14 reserved + smaller burst); @dylan_ml prepare 1-pager on KV warmup impact and p95 expectations; @sara_security draft short KMS/audit answers. I'll present two options to ClearBank and propose a POC week.

jen_devops: On it, will post numbers by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

dylan_ml: Will include assumptions (kv hit %, avg seq), and variance ranges.

sara_security: Drafting answers now.

mike_sales: Thanks team, will sync with customer once we have numbers.
